mentions.name: Appents
mentions.description: Appents provides a done-for-you social media solution for startups, handling their social media presence so early-stage companies can build an audience rather than launching with no visibility.
mentions.problem: Most early-stage startups ignore social media until after a launch, and a launch makes little impact if no one knows the product exists.
